| Rank Range | Exam 1 (Midterm Joint Exam) | Exam 2 (Baseline / First Diagnostic Exam) |

| Top 70     | 46                          | 45                                         |

Notes:
- Class 314 midterm: 46 students; Class 314 first diagnostic: 45 students.
- Ranking derived from 'Weighted Total Score' (descending), no pre-existing rank column used.

- Top 50 and Top 70 counts equal the total class size for each exam because the class has only 46 and 45 students respectively.

question: For Class 314, count how many students placed in each of the following rank ranges — Top 10, Top 20, Top 50, and Top 70 — across two exams (midterm joint exam and baseline exam), and output the comparison results in table form. The table contains three columns: Rank Range (Top 10 / Top 20 / Top 50 / Top 70), Number of Students in Exam 1, Number of Students in Exam 2. If the data contains a total score or ranking column, use it preferentially; if there is no ranking column, rank by total score in descending order before counting; if tied ranks exist, apply the "seat-occupying method" (i.e., 3 students tied for 10th place occupy ranks 10, 11, and 12, so only students ranked up to 9th are counted within the Top 10).
